name: The Fair Unknown
source:
Three knights set out from the court of King Arthur. Solid Sir Kay, warm Sir Gawain, and Lancelot, the greatest, and least contented, knight of her time. Along the way they'll face strange monsters, harsh trials, and revelations that will leave them changed forever.

A visual novel of knighthood, impossible wanting, and what you do when everything you love leaves you bleeding.

[From [url=https://maidandlion.itch.io/the-fair-unknown]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
三位骑士自亚瑟王的宫廷启程出征：沉稳可靠的凯爵士、热情温暖的高文爵士，以及当代最负盛名却也最难言满足的女骑士兰斯洛特。一路上，她们将直面诡异莫测的魔物、严酷无情的试炼，以及足以将她们彻底改变的惊人真相。

一部探讨骑士精神、求而不得的渴念，以及当所爱的一切都令你遍体鳞伤时该如何抉择的视觉小说。

[摘自[url=https://maidandlion.itch.io/the-fair-unknown]itch.io[/url]]
